title: BFE: blockchain-governed federation of tree ensembles for in-hospital mortality prediction (code)
description: Code for the study 'Blockchain-Governed Federation of Tree Ensembles for In-Hospital Mortality Prediction: Poisoning Resistance, Calibration and Cost in Simulated MIMIC-IV Hospital Consortia'. Hospitals commit SHA-256 digests of locally trained XGBoost and random-forest models to a Solidity smart contract, peers post digest-bound validation AUROCs, and the contract admits models whose median peer AUROC is at least 0.70. Includes comparators, attack scenarios, statistics and figures. No patient data are included; MIMIC-IV is available from PhysioNet to credentialed users.
